'''Fishing junk''' is the least valuable category of [[fishing]] loot. A catch is junk 10% of the time in most biomes, less with {{MCW|Luck of the Sea}}, and 95% of the time in biomes without fish.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing.json}}</ref>

== Loot ==
All biomes share the base items. Three groups of biomes add one or two items of their own, which changes every item's share.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref>

Jungles are Jungle, Sparse Jungle and Bamboo Jungle. Swamps are Swamp and Mangrove Swamp. Multiply a share by 0.1 for its chance per catch in a fish biome (for example, a lily pad is 2.18% of all catches).

Estus Ash was added to junk so that players on Peaceful can get it.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Estus Ash added to Junk pool (For peaceful players)}}</ref> Most junk plays the junk [[fishing sounds|catch sound]]. Fish bones, nautilus shells, axolotls, frogs and tadpoles have their own.
